title: Minecraft for Nintendo Switch 2 launches 27 Oct: Vibrant Visuals by default, free Standard Edition for Switch 1 digital owners until end of Jan 2027
sound: trailer (Vibrant Visuals launch trailer music from 12 s, speech none)

sources.note: 7 Oct: launching 27 Oct; free digital Standard Edition for Switch 1 digital owners until end of January 2027 in most territories (Japan, Taiwan, Thailand small fee); Deluxe and Ultimate at discounted upgrade fees; all versions include the Super Mario Mash-Up Pack
5 Aug: Vibrant Visuals set as the default visual experience

Mojang's Vibrant Visuals launch trailer (17 Jun 2025), 1080p, 4.7 Mbps (lowbit flag), decode clean; no Switch 2 footage on an allowed route (Nintendo's Direct trailer is YouTube-only; store page images only); credited on screen

claims.text: free Standard Edition for Switch 1 digital owners until end Jan 2027

drafts.x: تصل Minecraft إلى Nintendo Switch 2 غدًا، 27 أكتوبر، بمظهر Vibrant Visuals مفعّلًا افتراضيًا، والنسخة الأساسية مجانية لمن يملك اللعبة رقميًا على Switch حتى نهاية يناير 2027، حسب شركة موجانغ (Mojang).
